text: Agar cubes that have been stained with a blue indicator can be used to investigate diffusion.
When ascorbic acid, A, diffuses into a stained agar cube, it causes the cube to decolourise (the
blue colour disappears).
The end-point is reached when the cube has decolourised.
You will investigate the effect of changing the surface area to volume ratio of agar cubes on the
diffusion of ascorbic acid by:
• cutting a block of stained agar, B, into cubes of different sizes
• putting cubes of different sizes into ascorbic acid, A
• recording the time taken for each size of agar cube to reach the end-point.
You are provided with the materials shown in Table 1.1.
